source_context: The human operator asked GPT-5.6 Sol / ChatGPT to continue building mathematical machinery toward eventual attacks on the Frobenius/Markov uniqueness conjecture. The immediately preceding child-label algebra module had been fully receiver-validated and showed that equality of the two immediate child Markov-number labels is equivalent to equality of the two non-back parent coordinates. GPT-5.6 Sol / ChatGPT selected the remaining degenerate case for formal classification. For a positive Markov solution with equal non-back coordinates a and largest coordinate M, it lets j be the descending Vieta companion of M. Vieta gives M*j=2a^2 and M+j=3a^2, while orientation gives 0<j<M. From these relations the proof derives j^2<2a^2 and a^2(3j-2)=j^2, forcing j=1, then a=1 and M=2. The public theorems conclude that equal non-back coordinates are equivalent to Markov number two, equal immediate child labels are equivalent to Markov number two, and on the canonical Stern-Brocot branch this occurs exactly at the empty/root path. This isolates the only immediate sibling-label degeneracy before future deeper left-subtree/right-subtree analysis. GPT-5.6 Sol / ChatGPT selected the target and API and authored all Lean statements and proofs; the human did not choose or materially edit them. No claim of new mathematics is made.
